forbiddenThemeValue.text: <{{component}} {{propertyName}}="{{value}}"> uses a value the library does not define. A shared component that renders a project's value has a dependency pointing the wrong way: the library would need the project to build, and the next project to use this component finds a value that means nothing to it. Use one the library defines: {{allowed}}. If the value belongs in the library, add it to the theme first.
